entries.explicitly_unused_scope: scanned pages, bitmap OCR, layout detection, table/figure recognition, formula recognition
entries.cpu_behavior: CPU-capable; pure Rust/C++ parser, no model inference
entries.known_risks: only born-digital/programmatic PDFs; scanned pages get weak/no text layer and require a visual adapter
entries.upgrade_strategy: pin the exact production dependency; rerun parser contract, Golden Set, and production path tests on bump

entries.official_interface_used: PaddleOCRVL(pipeline_version='v1.6', layout_detection_model_name='PP-DocLayoutV3', layout_detection_model_dir=verified_layout_dir, vl_rec_model_name='PaddleOCR-VL-1.6-0.9B', vl_rec_model_dir=verified_vlm_dir, use_doc_orientation_classify=False, use_doc_unwarping=False, use_layout_detection=True, use_chart_recognition=False, use_seal_recognition=False, use_ocr_for_image_block=False); pipeline.predict(image)
entries.explicitly_unused_scope: chart recognition, plot digitization, curve recovery, scatter-point recovery, human parse revision
entries.cpu_behavior: paddlepaddle==3.2.1 is approved only for device=cpu after an isolated local-bundle Live predict probe, and reconfirmed by the full frozen-Golden-Set paired benchmark executed in-process against the verified bundle: 20 latency-measured cases, double-run report identity sha256:58f706c2defc3f723edebe32fa57d57d07a00ae4f226ed9d0965a34ad21b4654
entries.gpu_behavior: paddlepaddle-gpu==3.2.1 remains deferred with probe_evidence=not_run and is not approved by CPU evidence
entries.network_behavior: runtime network access is disabled; provisioning uses only the pinned Hugging Face snapshot and PaddleX 3.6.0 official BOS source
entries.model_download_behavior: implicit runtime download is forbidden; both verified local model directories are required before PaddleOCRVL construction
entries.cache_behavior: unknown or name-matching cache directories are rejected; only directories matching every committed file size/hash are accepted
entries.offline_behavior: runtime is fully offline after the separately provisioned content-addressed bundle is verified
entries.known_risks: heavyweight optional runtime; CPU fallback is slow; any package, pipeline policy, component or asset digest change requires a new adoption review
entries.upgrade_strategy: re-resolve exact PaddleX package config, provision every enabled component, regenerate file and bundle digests, then rerun local-load and predict probes
